description: The module the rest of the plugin hangs off: it logs you in, chooses the room you are in, and holds the connections to the other people in it
notes: nothing is patched here; every jack in this plugin is on an expander beside the Hub, and the row of modules has to touch with no gap
a QR code fills the panel until this copy of Rack has been paired: scan it with a phone or open the address in a browser to log in
the dot in the corner is green when connected, amber and pulsing with a countdown while it retries, red after a failure and grey when offline
click the room name for the rooms you belong to, and the QR icon under it for an invite somebody else can scan
a CV Peer is added to the right of the row on its own each time somebody new joins the room, so you do not place one per person
expanders go to the right of the Hub; Resonance Monitor is the one that goes to the left
menu: Deauthorize Device — logs out and returns the panel to the QR code
Echo Mode — sends everything received straight back to whoever sent it, so a second copy of Rack in the same room hears your own signals return
Auto-add Peer: CV Only, CV + MIDI I/O — sets whether a new arrival gets a CV Peer on its own or a CV Peer with a MIDI I/O beside it
Add Peer Now — adds a CV Peer straight away, in place of leaving it until somebody joins
Copy Event Log — puts a timestamped list of connection events on the clipboard
